remaining_cautions.finding: DRAMP32885 lists Antimicrobial and broad Anticancer activity, but local primary material supports sub peptide14-39 cancer-cell nuclear internalization and drug-delivery potential, not antimicrobial MIC/MBC or direct cancer-cell killing.
The local DOCX supplement contains Supplementary Figures 1-3, Supplementary Table 1, and sample-size data, but no structured MIC/activity table; graph-only image values were not fabricated.
Selective cancer-cell nuclear internalization supports a delivery-tool claim, but cargo transport and anticancer efficacy remain future-work context rather than direct activity rows.
